text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: GPU queue 'reservoir' at 98% in eu-west-1 for tenant prod-123. Autoscaler tried 3 scaleups but provider returned quota_denied. Average token latency > 2.5s for last 5m. Creating triage thread.
Jamal: saw it, joining now. what services are hot?
Kate SRE: incoming queue growth looks like async batch jobs + a traffic spike from one customer. queue_len: 14k -> 48k over 12m. throttles increasing on pool-gpu-eu-1.
Alex Infra: provider error: `QuotaExceeded: GPUs per-region limit reached (requested 8, available 0)` from alloc call. We have pending scale attempts in autoscaler logs.
Maria Eng: grabbing logs.
Maria Eng: found repeated scale attempts: `scale_attempt id=ae3f ... reason=queue_threshold` then `allocation_failed quota_exceeded`.
Jamal: ok immediate mitigation options? can we divert traffic to other regions or fallback model?
Kate SRE: quick mitigations ordered by speed: 1) enable fallback routing to cpu-hotline for non-latency-critical requests (lower cost model), 2) shift a subset of EU traffic to us-west-2 where capacity is healthy, 3) throttle tenant prod-123 by rate-limit policy.
Alex Infra: can enable cross-region routing, but cookie/latency for customer might increase. doing permission check now.
Ryan PM: tagging for customer impact — Amy from CS please loop prod-123 contacts, they might see errors.
Amy CS: on it. I'll send interim note: "We're investigating elevated errors/latency; engineering mitigation in progress".
Linda EngOps: creating temporary quota request with provider support, but that's multi-hour. ETA unknown.
Maria Eng: pushing a hotfix to autoscaler to abort repeated rapid retries (we're seeing tight retry loops causing thrashing). patch ready, can deploy to staging in 2m then prod if green.
Jamal: do the patch. we need to avoid further allocation storms.
Kate SRE: I'll open a canary that reroutes 20% of prod-123 to us-west-2. Alex, need your help to spin the route.
Alex Infra: starting route change: `rbac apply route prod-123 -> us-west-2 (20%)`. Command: ```sh
infractl route update --tenant prod-123 --split 80:20 --regions eu-west-1,us-west-2
```
Alex Infra: route command applied, waiting for edge propagation (~30s).
Maria Eng: deploying autoscaler hotfix now: bump backoff, stop immediate retries. Deploying canary to autoscaler-eu cluster.
incident-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deployment started for autoscaler-eu at 8390001220.
Kate SRE: seeing immediate drop in allocation attempts after hotfix canary. queue growth rate stabilizing.
Jamal: monitor metrics — queue len, throttle ratio, per-tenant errors.
Maria Eng: can confirm backlog rate dropped from +300% to +40% over last 4min.
Amy CS: customer contacted and acknowledged. they reported 25% error rate on inference calls during spike window. I've opened a support case and asked for any traffic anomalies on their side.
Ryan PM: note for customer comms: prepare a postmortem summary and ETA for full remediation.
Linda EngOps: provider support responded: we can get temporary quota increase if we escalate; they asked for justification + expected sustained GPU hours. I've started the escalated ticket.
Alex Infra: provisionally starting warm pools in us-west-2 to absorb more traffic if needed.
Jamal: good. who will own post-incident action items?
Kate SRE: I'll own immediate actions: 1) finalize autoscaler retry/backoff fix (PR 4721), 2) add guardrail to prevent aggressive fanout when allocations fail, 3) alert rule to detect quota errors faster.
Maria Eng: I'll own model-fallback play improvement and test reroute workflows.
Alex Infra: I'll own provider quota runbook updates and automated escalation (make quota request via infractl).
Amy CS: I'll own customer communication and a short timeline for impacted tenants.
Ryan PM: I'll coordinate postmortem and link to this thread; want a root-cause writeup and risk mitigations within 48h.
Jamal: thumbs. any residual impact?
Kate SRE: last check: queue at 9k, throttles at 12%, latency trending down. No major customer-facing errors currently, but we'll keep page open for 2h.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: incident-severity: high. page duration so far: 18m. incident channel auto-archive scheduled in 2h if quiet.
Maria Eng: quick notes for postmortem: - cause: autoscaler retry storm + provider region quota exhaustion + concentrated tenant spike - contributing: lack of allocation guardrail, insufficient cross-region fallbacks, slow provider quota escalation path - mitigation applied: route split to us-west-2, autoscaler backoff patch, provider escalation ticket opened - customer impact: ~25% error rate for prod-123 for ~12m, token latency spike ~2x - action items: see assigned owners above.
Jamal: thanks team. closing live triage. please add any logs/links to the postmortem doc. I'll create a postmortem draft and ping owners. :thumbsup:
Kate SRE: adding dashboards/links: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/queue-reservoir?orgId=1&from=now-30m&to=now
Maria Eng: logs: https://logs.redwood.internal/prod-123?from=now-60m
Amy CS: sent customer note and scheduled follow-up call for 30m.
Ryan PM: creating postmortem doc now: https://docs.redwood.internal/postmortems/8390001111-queue-reservoir-draft (will ping when ready).
Linda EngOps: opened provider escalation ticket #PROV-5591. response ETA 3-6h.
Jamal: keeping thread live for 2h. good job all.
Kate SRE: post-incident checklist: run full chaos tests for autoscaler, add quota-exhaustion runbook, and update runbooks to include immediate route split step. I'll create JIRA tasks.
Maria Eng: will also add unit + integration test for abort-on-quota behavior in autoscaler.
incident-bot: :page_facing_up: Incident resolved (live triage closed) at 8390001520. Summary saved to incident tracker."
